title: HIT PAUSE
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, item 6. The frame a pillager or a machine takes a hit, its pose now freezes for a split second (60 ms) before it moves on, the beat that makes a hit feel solid in the games he named. The hit jolt still plays over it. It follows EFFECT INTENSITY: half at HALF, none at OFF. You and your teammate never freeze, and it is drawn only: every position, hit and number in the fight is exactly as before.
now: Hits have weight: a pillager or machine that takes a hit freezes for a split second.
